tiers.text: Ask for one step, the command and its output, and what you can run to check it. Run that, look, then commit.
./gate check prints the first thing that is missing. Paste that line to Claude.
Look at the page with the question in mind, and read the column file for your dataset in data/: it describes every column. A wrong answer at ./gate unlock prints a hint.
The gate unlock answer depends on your dataset: ask your leader (the facilitator walkthrough has it).
